criteria.statement: Placement validation checks BackupDefinition executor labels and capability requirements against registered worker labels, capabilities, liveness, and scheduling state.
Backend lifecycle capability requirements are checked through BackupBackendResolver before a definition is considered placeable.
Executor selection policy supports deterministic least-queued and all-eligible resolution from definition targeting constraints.
Placement decisions expose structured reasons for global unplaceability and candidate-specific rejection causes.
Definitions without explicit capability requirements fail closed to workers advertising the generic backup workload capability.
